_note: Cache + S3 storage commands. Sources: db/management/commands/clear_cache.py:1-30, create_bucket.py:1-61, update_bucket.py:1-187.
bugs: BUGS: create_bucket int()s the head_bucket error code (:37) but update_bucket compares it as a string (:152) — the two commands classify the same S3 errors differently; PORT each as written.

BUGS (policy probe side effect): update_bucket's PutBucketPolicy permission probe (:80-98) applies a real public-read policy (GetObject, Principal *, Resource arn:aws:s3:::<bucket>/*) to the bucket as the probe itself — a read-only-looking check that mutates bucket policy. PORT.
BUGS: update_bucket head_bucket non-404 ClientError (:155-156) prints 'Error: ...' and FALLS THROUGH to the 'exists.' success line (:158) — PORT.
BUGS: update_bucket GetObject probe (:49-60) silently skips when the bucket is empty (no 'Contents' key) leaving s3:GetObject False with no message — PORT.

Quirk: if check_s3_permissions raises a non-ClientError (e.g. NoCredentialsError), `permissions` is unbound and the NameError is caught at :174-175 ('Error: ...'), then execution falls through to the permissions.json fallback — PORT.
